verses.1: Oh those who came from Egypt to help us! They relied on horses for transportation. They trusted in their chariots, thinking they were numerous enough. But they did not trust in the Holy Israelite God, and they did not seek out Jehovah.
verses.2: And he was also wise. But he brought harm upon himself, and he didn’t get rid of his evil ways. He settled in the home of the wicked, and relied on the help of those who were evil.
verses.3: And from Egypt, man came forth, not God. Their horses were also just animals, not spirits. But Jehovah will stretch out His hand and help them. They will all be able to live together.
verses.4: For as Jehovah said, “When the lion rises up against its prey, it will not be able to resist the sound of its roar. Nor will it be able to withstand those who attack it.” In the same way, Jehovah’s army will descend from heaven to attack Mount Zion and its surroundings.
verses.5: Like birds flying high, so will Jehovah’s army protect Jerusalem from harm. They will save Pasch and deliver them from danger.
verses.6: Return to that time when the children of Israel became more deeply rooted in their faith.
verses.7: For on that day, those who are magicians and sorcerers will be destroyed. They are those who have done evil deeds through their magic tricks.
verses.8: And Assyria will fall into ruin. No one or no human being will be able to save us from it. It will be destroyed by the hands of those who stand before its ruins.
verses.9: And his rock will be removed from its place; its branches will be broken. Thus will say Jehovah, who has illuminated him in Zion and given him light in Jerusalem.
